name: Hourglass
description: The wasp. The same sealed suit, tailored: the chest shell drawn in to nothing at the waist and flaring again into a skirt of segmented abdomen plates banded in dark green and black — the hourglass it used to be, worn as a silhouette — and two long membrane panels folded down the back from the shoulders, veined, that lift a hair when she breathes: a wing-cape. On the near hip rides a tether drum with the counterweight wound on it, a Soldier's head-plate packed solid, which is what she swings when the hive closes; it is stowed, not carried. She stands with the near hand set on that hip. Two dead feelers curve back from the crown in the same dark green as the bands. Same dead core in the chest. Drawn facing +x; the game flips it.

idle.description: a stance with the weight on one hip and the near hand set on it: a breath through the drawn-in chest, the folded wing panels lifting a hair on the rise, the feelers curving back and sweeping slow

walk.description: a stride the hips lead: the tassets swing over the thighs, the wing panels tilt off the back with each step, the stowed weight rides the hip, and the near arm keeps its hand at the drum
